## Property Types

- [Townhome](https://eastbrookhomes.com/property-types/townhome/): Experience the easy of Townhome living! Our efficient yet spacious townhome home plans offer you a brand-new home at a lower price point, with the added benefit of low-maintenance living.
- [Courtyard Homes](https://eastbrookhomes.com/property-types/courtyard-homes/): Courtyard homes truly deserved their own category as they offer a hybrid of lifestyles: low-maintenance benefits with single-family home features and layouts.
- [Single Family Home](https://eastbrookhomes.com/property-types/single-family-home/): Discover your dream Single-Family home! We take great care in designing Singal Family home plans that fit a wide range of lifestyles, features, and price points
- [Condominium](https://eastbrookhomes.com/property-types/condominium/): Explore Eastbrook’s unique Condominium lifestyles! If you’re interested in a low-maintenance lifestyle, we have so many different options for you to consider
